required_input: Bounding-box annotations for all 4 classes (rider, with_helmet, without_helmet, number_plate) in YOLO format
required_split: train/val/test split by session/segment (temporal separation to avoid leakage)
required_transcriptions: Verified number-plate text for OCR accuracy evaluation
required_association: Rider-to-plate association ground truth for violation evaluation
note: No pseudo-labels used as ground truth per scientific-integrity rules.
